questions.question: What is digital illustration?
choices: Creating images with digital drawing or painting tools

questions.question: What is a layer useful for in illustration software?
choices: Editing parts of an image independently

questions.question: What does a raster image consist of?
What is a key advantage of vector artwork?
choices: It stores more colors than any raster image
It can scale while keeping edges crisp

questions.question: Why use a sketch layer before clean line art?
choices: It allows composition and pose ideas to be tested before refinement
It permanently locks the final image

questions.question: What does opacity control for a layer or brush?
choices: How transparent or solid it appears

questions.question: How can a clipping mask help?
choices: It changes a raster image to sound
It limits paint or edits to the shape of another layer

questions.question: Why choose canvas dimensions based on intended use?
choices: Every platform uses the same size
Resolution needs differ for screen display and print

questions.question: What is line art?
choices: Defined lines that clarify contours or details
A layer containing only background color

questions.question: How can an artist create depth in a digital illustration?
choices: Keep every object the same size and value
Use overlap, scale, value, and atmospheric cues

questions.question: What does color picking from a reference help an artist do?
choices: Sample a color to compare or reuse it

questions.question: Why save an editable project file as well as an export?
choices: The export always contains the same layer controls
The project preserves layers and working edits for future revision

questions.question: A digital brush looks jagged at normal zoom. What should be checked?
choices: Canvas resolution, brush settings, and display scale

questions.question: How can a limited palette support an illustration?
choices: It helps establish a coherent mood and visual hierarchy
It removes the need for value contrast

questions.question: What is a selection tool commonly used for?
choices: Targeting a region for editing or transformation

questions.question: Why keep important illustration elements on separate layers?
choices: They automatically make the file smaller
They can be adjusted without repainting unrelated areas

questions.question: What is a brush stabilizer intended to help with?
choices: Smoothing the path of a digital stroke

questions.question: An illustration is hard to read at thumbnail size. What may help?
choices: Clarify the silhouette and simplify competing detail

questions.question: What should an artist consider before using another creator's digital brush or asset?
choices: Whether it is the newest version

questions.question: Why inspect an illustration at several zoom levels?
choices: It ensures every image prints perfectly
Different scales reveal composition and detail problems
